title: Dynamic machine-learning model for early prediction of intraoperative hypotension using 5-minute perioperative time-series data: a multicenter retrospective study.
summary: A retrospective multicenter study developed and internally validated a dynamic model from perioperative time series in 702 adults, then tested it in an independent 248-patient cohort. Random forest predicted MAP below 65 mmHg at the next scheduled five-minute point with AUROC 0.857 internally and 0.894 externally. Prospective clinical workflow benefit remains untested.
ai_technology: A dynamic machine-learning model used perioperative time-series data to predict intraoperative hypotension in a multicenter retrospective cohort.
organization: Department of Anesthesiology, The Second Affiliated Hospital of Fujian University of Traditional Chinese Medicine, China; Department of Anesthesiology, The First Affiliated Hospital of Xiamen University, School of Medicine, Xiamen University, China; Department of Pediatrics, Women & Infants Hospital of Rhode Island, Warren Alpert Medical School of Brown University, United States; Department of Anesthesiology, Fujian Maternity and Child Health Hospital College of Clinical Medicine for Obstetrics & Gynecology and Pediatrics, Fujian Medical University, China

evidence.tested: The primary abstract reports 702 development/internal-validation patients and an independent external cohort of 248. Using rolling five-minute perioperative data, random forest had internal AUROC 0.857 (95% CI 0.841–0.868), AUPRC 0.413 and Brier score 0.093; external AUROC was 0.894 (95% CI 0.875–0.907), AUPRC 0.540 and Brier score 0.092. The target was MAP below 65 mmHg at the next scheduled five-minute point. The study calls for prospective workflow evaluation.
evidence.unknown: An independent external cohort was evaluated, but prospective use in an anesthesia workflow and improvement in patient outcomes were not tested.
evidence.ai_role: A dynamic machine-learning model used perioperative time-series data to predict intraoperative hypotension in a multicenter retrospective cohort.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
